subject: general
question: Who among the following has NEVER played professional cricket for India?
solution:
The correct answer is __Vijendra Singh.__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vijendra Singh** has NEVER played professional cricket for India.
 
• Vijender Singh Beniwal is an **Indian professional boxer and politician.**
 
• As an amateur, he won a bronze medal at the 2008 Beijing Olympics, becoming the **first Indian boxer to win an Olympic medal.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Sourav Chandidas Ganguly**, affectionately known as Dada.
 
• He is an Indian cricket administrator, commentator and former national cricket team captain who is the **39th and current president of the Board of Control for Cricket in India.**
 
• **Virender Sehwag **is a former Indian cricketer. He represented India from 1999 to 2013.
 
 
• He played for Delhi and Haryana in Indian domestic cricket.
 
 
 
• **Harbhajan Singh** is a Member of Parliament, Rajya Sabha and a former Indian cricketer and cricket commentator who played for the Indian national cricket team.
 
 
• A specialist spin bowler, Singh played for India between **1998 and 2016.**
